result.rationale: The diff shows `sidekiq_options retry: false` in Jobs::PollFeed and the loop `rss.items.each do |i| ... content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` with no per-item error handling. If any single item raises (e.g., nil i.content, invalid URI in TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls, or a RecordNotUnique race on the unique embed_url index), the entire run aborts and all remaining feed items are skipped for that hour with no retry — a real correctness/robustness defect introduced by this new code.
